title: Fridge Sensor Fault
fullDescription:
F1 on Hotpoint refrigerators indicates the fridge NTC temperature probe is reading out of range. The compressor may run continuously or cycle badly.

Replacement sensors are inexpensive; access is usually via the rear interior panel.

faq.a: Check contents if compartment was warm.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F2 means the freezer temperature sensor is out of range. Freezer may run warm or over-cold.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F3 indicates the defrost sensor has failed; defrost cycle cannot be correctly terminated resulting in ice build-up.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: F4 indicates the evaporator defrost heater or bi-metal thermostat has failed, leading to ice build-up and loss of cooling.

title: Fan Fault
fullDescription: F5 indicates the circulation fan is not turning. May be iced, obstructed, or electrically failed.

title: Compressor Fault
fullDescription: F6 indicates the compressor is not starting or drawing abnormal current. Usually relay or compressor failure.

title: Door Ajar Alarm
fullDescription: F7 indicates the door has been open too long or the door switch has failed.

title: Ice Maker Fault
fullDescription: F8 means the ice maker cannot complete its cycle — frozen water tube, failed mould heater, or ejector jam.

title: Water Filter Warning
fullDescription: F9 is informational — the internal water filter usage timer has elapsed. Replace filter and reset the counter.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Twist out and install new filter.

faq.a: Use bypass plug for unfiltered water.

title: Control Board Fault
shortDescription: Main PCB fault or EEPROM error.
fullDescription: F10 indicates a main control board fault — firmware corruption or failed relay. Often needs PCB replacement.
